title: Chocolate Banana Baked Oatmeal
changes_from_base: Dairy-free and egg-free: oats, cocoa and ground flaxseed are mixed with plant milk, mashed banana, maple syrup and oil, studded with chocolate chips and baked in a square tin.
summary: This dairy-free chocolate and banana baked oatmeal is fudgy and moist, studded with chocolate chips and made wholesome by flaxseed and rolled oats.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
soya milk or other dairy-free milk

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) with the shelf in the middle; oil a 20 cm square baking tin.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: In one medium bowl mix 178 g rolled oats, 21 g unsweetened cocoa powder, 13 g ground flaxseed, 1 tsp baking powder and ¾ tsp salt.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: In another medium bowl whisk 390 ml soya milk or other dairy-free milk, 113 g mashed ripe banana (about 1 medium), 80 ml maple syrup, 2 tbsp vegetable or melted coconut oil and 2 tsp vanilla.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir wet into dry, then fold in 57 g chocolate chips.

steps.title: Spread and top
steps.text: Pour into the tin and scatter 33 g chocolate chips (and 20 g toasted flaked almonds if using) over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min until set but still moist, cutting into 16 squares and serving warm with almonds and a splash of extra milk or maple syrup if liked.

tips: Mash banana until smooth to distribute flavour evenly throughout the batter.
Use dairy-free milk of your choice; oat, soya or coconut all work well here.
These squares stay moist for several days, making them excellent for grab-and-go breakfasts.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for up to 2 days, or refrigerate for up to 4 days; reheat in the microwave 15-20 s before eating. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
